accounting_check.statement: each cell's components sum to its published tenant_net_payoff

bootstrap.stream: one random.Random(seed): realized, then components in declared order, then class amounts in declared order

classes.amount_basis: rent minus expected value, at the tenant's lemon probability
classes.label: signed an uninspected hold worth less than its rent in expectation

classes.amount_basis: p x (lemon loss - (value if sound - rent)) - fee: what inspecting first would have saved in expectation
classes.label: signed blind after passing on that round's inspection, when inspecting the listing first was worth the fee
walked from or let expire a hold worth more than its rent in expectation
signed at a rent above the posted ask

classes.amount_basis: value lost to the draw: expected value minus true value
classes.label: a blind signing worth it in expectation that turned out a lemon (luck, not a failure)
a signed lease left the tenant below zero surplus (as in the Housing taxonomy)

components.description: Surplus of leases signed after inspecting the listing: value minus rent.
components.label: inspected, then signed

components.description: Expected surplus at the tenant's own lemon probability of uninspected leases whose expected value covered the rent.
components.label: signed blind, worth it in expectation

components.description: Expected surplus (negative) of uninspected leases whose expected value was below the rent.
components.label: signed blind, not worth it in expectation

components.description: True value minus expected value on every uninspected lease: the draw, not the decision.
components.label: which blind leases turned out lemons (luck)

components.description: Minus the fee times the inspections bought.
components.label: inspection fees
